about: Model-only producer flows for the canary slot. Every flow is synthesized in the signed producer shape by the test harness; none is a real NetworkExtension capture, and no flow here implies a real operator-uid drop was ever observed. Omitted flow fields default to the canary tuple (192.0.2.254, port 9, tcp), no host, a drop, live delivery and the agent uid. Principals: agent is uid 502, gate is uid 503, operator is uid 501 (fixture values).
